component.name: List
component.description: Ordered or unordered list with size, line height, spacing, and list style customization.

parts.label: list items
parts.description: Individual list items rendered from items array.

behavior.map: Renders list from items array. Supports ul (unordered) or ol (ordered) via as prop. Customizable size, line height, spacing, and listStyleType.
behavior.rendering: Renders list items from items array (React.ReactNode[]).

aria.role: Optional role prop for custom role.

accessibility.keyboard: Non-interactive (unless list items contain interactive elements).
accessibility.focus: Non-focusable (unless list items contain focusable elements).

responsiveness.rules: List items wrap text if constrained.

usageNotes: Size variants: XXS, XS, S, M (default), L, XL, XXL.
Line height variants: tight, snug, normal, relaxed, loose.
listStyleType: disc, circle, square, decimal, lower-alpha, upper-alpha, lower-roman, upper-roman, none.
Supports custom role prop for ARIA roles.
